column1: # Measured wall seconds of one package under `go test` in the go-quality test leg (CHAOS-10355), the weight ci/go_race_shard.awk balances the test shards by
# (`check_go.sh ci-leg test K 4`). Re-measured for CHAOS-13270: nearest-rank p90 of the uncached `ok <pkg> <n>s` lines of the 4 test legs of 6 full-plan go-quality runs
# p90 is the largest). Rows: every package of p90 >= 20 s, and every package that already had a row. A package with no row weighs 1. The weights only need to be roughly right: a wrong one
# costs balance, never coverage (the shards always partition `go list ./...`). Key = import path relative to the module root.
# Sorted (LC_ALL=C), no duplicates; internal/cigates/testshard checks each row names a real package.

# CHAOS-13356: deploy/helm/dev-health, internal/cigates/outboundtransport and internal/gqlgenguard re-measured by the same rule over the go-quality test-1 legs of main 42566456600, 42560896652, 42559790848 and PR #5968 run 42566503520 (4 values each, so p90 is the largest).
